sp1_note:
Attention:
As a recommended precaution, Sa‘i should be performed immediately after completing Tawaf and its prayer, although the apparent ruling is that delaying it until night is permissible.
Under normal circumstances, it is not permissible to delay Sa‘i until the following day; that is, it must not be delayed until after the Fajr prayer.
If Sa‘i is deliberately delayed until the following day, as an obligatory precaution, Tawaf and its prayer must be repeated.
It is permissible to perform Tawaf before the Fajr prayer, then perform the Fajr prayer, and perform Sa‘i afterwards.
sp2_guidance_covering_requirement: Sa‘i must be performed on the ground floor or in the basement. Sa‘i performed on the upper floors is invalid.
sp2_guidance_purity_requirement: Ritual purity through Wudu or Ghusl is not required for Sa‘i, although it is recommended.
sp2_guidance_mustahab_not_obligatory: The Sa‘i of a person in the state of Janabah is valid, and they must perform it personally.
sp2_guidance_women_validity: The Sa‘i of a woman experiencing menstruation or postnatal bleeding is valid, and she must perform it personally.
sp2_guidance_body_purity: The body is not required to be free from impurity for Sa‘i, although this is recommended.
sp2_guidance_dhikr_recommendation: It is recommended to remain engaged in the remembrance of Allah and the transmitted supplications.
sp2_guidance_wheelchair_rule: Under normal circumstances, a person may use a wheelchair subject to the prescribed conditions; however, performing Sa‘i on foot is preferable.
sp2_guidance_proxy_rule: A person who cannot perform Sa‘i even by wheelchair must appoint a proxy.
sp21_walking_not_required: Walking is not a condition for Sa‘i. Therefore, a person may voluntarily perform Sa‘i using a wheelchair or similar means, whether operating it personally or having someone else move it, provided that the person can stop it whenever they wish without asking the operator.
sp21_proxy_if_cannot: If a person cannot perform Sa‘i personally, even with assistance, and no one can take them through Sa‘i, they must appoint a proxy.
sp2_how_sai_count_rule: Sa‘i consists of seven circuits. Travelling from Safa to Marwah counts as one circuit, and travelling from Marwah to Safa counts as another. The seventh circuit ends at Marwah.
sp2_how_sai_complete_distance: The entire distance between Safa and Marwah must be covered. Each circuit must begin from the designated starting point at Safa or Marwah. Ascending the hill itself is not obligatory, although it is recommended.
sp2_how_sai_mountain_parts: When travelling from Safa to Marwah, the body must face Marwah, and when returning from Marwah to Safa, the body must face Safa. However, turning the head and looking around during Sa‘i is permissible.
sp2_how_sai_direction_rule: Customary continuity must be maintained between the circuits. However, there is no problem with sitting to rest at Safa, Marwah, or anywhere between them.
sp2_how_sai_continuity_rule: Sleeping during Sa‘i invalidates the Sa‘i.
sp5_intention: Intention: I perform the Sa‘i of my Umrah al-Mufradah, seeking nearness to Allah.
sp5_recommended_go_to_safa: Walk calmly and with dignity until reaching the first marker, where the brisk walk begins.
sp5_recommended_dhikr: Then jog lightly until reaching the second marker, where the brisk walk ends. Try to bring yourself to tears, supplicate to Allah frequently, and express your need before Him.
sp5_recommended_continue_walk: Then walk calmly and with dignity until reaching the top of Marwah.
sp5_harwala_item1: Walk calmly and with dignity until reaching the first marker, where the brisk walk begins.
sp5_harwala_item2: Then increase your pace slightly until reaching the second marker, where the brisk walk ends. Try to bring yourself to tears, supplicate to Allah frequently, and express your need before Him.
sp5_harwala_item3: Then walk calmly and with dignity until reaching the top of Marwah.
sp6_optional_wheelchair_rule: Under normal circumstances—that is, when a person is able to perform Sa‘i on foot—a wheelchair is permissible only if the person performing Sa‘i can stop it without asking the person pushing it.
sp6_compelled_self_perform_rule: In a case of necessity, if your religious duty is to perform Sa‘i personally, you must be able to stop the wheelchair or other means yourself.
sp6_compelled_proxy_rule: In a case of necessity, if your religious duty is to have another person take you through Sa‘i, you are not required to have control over stopping the wheelchair or other means.
sp7_proxy_obligation_rule: A person who cannot perform Sa‘i personally, even with assistance, and cannot be taken through Sa‘i by another person, must appoint a proxy.
sp8_intro_instruction:
1. Proceed through the door facing the Black Stone towards Safa with calmness and dignity.
2. Upon ascending Safa, look towards the Kaaba and face the corner containing the Black Stone. Praise and glorify Allah and remember His blessings. 
Then say “Allahu Akbar” seven times.
sp8_notes_list:
3.Say “Alhamdulillah” seven times. 4. Say “La ilaha illallah” seven times. 5. Say three times: «لا إلهَ إلّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لا شَريكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لا يَمُوتُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ». 6. Then send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad. 7. Then say three times: «اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى مَا هَدَانَا، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى مَا أَوْلَانَا، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الْحَيِّ الْقَيُّومِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الْحَيِّ الدَّائِمِ». 8. Then say three times: «أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ، لا نَعْبُدُ إِلَّا إِيَّاهُ، مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْمُشْرِكُونَ». 9. Then say three times: «اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ وَالْيَقِينَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ».10. Then say three times: «اللَّهُمَّ آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ». 11. Then say “Allahu Akbar” one hundred times. 12. Say “La ilaha illallah” one hundred times. 13. Say “Alhamdulillah” one hundred times. 14. Say “Subhanallah” one hundred times. 15. Then say: «لا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ، أَنْجَزَ وَعْدَهُ، وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ، وَغَلَبَ الْأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ، فَلَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَحْدَهُ وَحْدَهُ. اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِي الْمَوْتِ وَفِيمَا بَعْدَ الْمَوْتِ. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ ظُلْمَةِ الْقَبْرِ وَوَحْشَتِهِ. اللَّهُمَّ أَظِلَّنِي فِي ظِلِّ عَرْشِكَ يَوْمَ لا ظِلَّ إِلَّا ظِلُّكَ». 16. Entrust your religion, yourself, your family, and your dependants to Allah, and repeat this frequently. 17. Then say:
«أَسْتَوْدِعُ اللَّهَ الرَّحْمَنَ الرَّحِيمَ الَّذِي لا تَضِيعُ وَدَائِعُهُ نَفْسِي وَدِينِي وَأَهْلِي. اللَّهُمَّ اسْتَعْمِلْنِي عَلَى كِتَابِكَ وَسُنَّةِ نَبِيِّكَ، وَتَوَفَّنِي عَلَى مِلَّتِهِ، وَأَعِذْنِي مِنَ الْفِتْنَةِ». 18. Then say “Allahu Akbar” three times. 20. Then say “Allahu Akbar” once and repeat it again. If you cannot perform all of these acts, perform as much as you can. 21. It is narrated that whenever Imam Ali (peace be upon him) ascended Safa, he would stand facing the Kaaba, raise his hands, and say:
«اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي كُلَّ ذَنْبٍ أَذْنَبْتُهُ قَطُّ، فَإِنْ عُدْتُ فَعُدْ عَلَيَّ بِالْمَغْفِرَةِ، فَإِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ. اللَّهُمَّ افْعَلْ بِي مَا أَنْتَ أَهْلُهُ، فَإِنَّكَ إِنْ تَفْعَلْ بِي مَا أَنْتَ أَهْلُهُ تَرْحَمْنِي، وَإِنْ تُعَذِّبْنِي فَأَنْتَ غَنِيٌّ عَنْ عَذَابِي، وَأَنَا مُحْتَاجٌ إِلَى رَحْمَتِكَ، فَيَا مَنْ أَنَا مُحْتَاجٌ إِلَى رَحْمَتِهِ ارْحَمْنِي. اللَّهُمَّ لا تَفْعَلْ بِي مَا أَنَا أَهْلُهُ، فَإِنَّكَ إِنْ تَفْعَلْ بِي مَا أَنَا أَهْلُهُ تُعَذِّبْنِي وَلَمْ تَظْلِمْنِي. أَصْبَحْتُ أَتَّقِي عَدْلَكَ وَلا أَخَافُ جَوْرَكَ، فَيَا مَنْ هُوَ عَدْلٌ لا يَجُورُ ارْحَمْنِي». 22. Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) is reported to have said: “If you wish your wealth and possessions to increase, prolong your stay at Safa.” 23. It is recommended to perform Sa‘i between Safa and Marwah on foot. Walk calmly and with dignity until reaching the first marker, then perform Harwalah—walking briskly with a gentle jogging motion—until reaching the second marker. Harwalah is not prescribed for women 24. Then walk calmly and with dignity until ascending Marwah. Perform there the same acts performed at Safa, and return from Marwah to Safa in the same manner. 25. If using a conveyance, increase its speed slightly between the two markers. Strive to weep or bring yourself to tears, supplicate to Allah frequently, and humbly express your need before Him.
sp9_invalid_doubt_rule: Doubt about the number of laps during Sa‘i invalidates the Sa‘i.
sp10_certainty_more_laps: Certainty of Having Performed Extra Laps
sp10_certainty_less_laps: Certainty of Having Performed Fewer Laps
sp10_doubt_in_laps: Doubt in the Number of Laps
sp11_ruling_intro: If there is an increase in laps:
sp11_ruling_full_text:
If the increase in laps is done knowingly and intentionally, the Sa‘i is invalid.
If done out of ignorance of the ruling, the Sa‘i is valid, although repeating it is recommended as a precaution.
If done by mistake and one full extra lap (or slightly more than one lap) is added, the Sa‘i is valid; however, it is recommended to complete seven additional laps (meaning two full Sa‘i cycles), and the second Sa‘i would end at Safa.
If done by mistake and less than one extra lap is added, the Sa‘i is valid.
